title.ru: Сбои рейсов, перебронирование и требования пассажиров
title.en: Flight Disruptions, Rebooking and Passenger Claims

description.ru: Развивайте уверенное общение уровня B2 в сложных поездках по теме «Сбои рейсов, перебронирование и требования пассажиров», оценивая варианты, права, риски и культурный контекст.
description.en: Develop confident B2 communication for flight disruptions, rebooking and passenger claims by evaluating options, rights, risks, and cultural context.

objective.ru: Уверенно решать сложную ситуацию путешествия уровня B2, уточняя условия, дипломатично отстаивая позицию и согласовывая практическое решение.
objective.en: Handle a complex B2 travel situation confidently by clarifying conditions, advocating a position diplomatically, and agreeing a practical solution.

instructions.en: Match the English words with their translations.

data.question: Which response handles the travel situation most effectively?

options.text: The operational disruption cancelled the final sector, so I am requesting rerouting at the earliest opportunity rather than a refund.
The conditions and consequences are irrelevant, so the first available option should be accepted immediately.
There is no need to retain evidence or clarify who is responsible for the problem.

data.explanation: The correct response uses precise B2 travel language and considers conditions, rights, consequences, and practical action.
